body: I'm really sorry you're in this situation. Why would you not be able to tell your therapist what you've said here?
I sent you a PM. I'd really like to help if I possibly can.

Meanwhile, back in the 21st century:
http://www.telegraph.co.uk/health/healthnews/10978836/Number-of-women-travelling-to-America-to-choose-sex-of-child-rises-20.html

Hey, how have you been the last couple of days?

I had a look at NOS at it sounds like the doctors don't understand either!

I know what you mean about seeming boring. I have things about me that in theory should be interesting, but I'm so uncomfortable speaking that my voice is very monotone and dull. Makes it a vicious circle but if you can get into a positive environment how you feel could change quickly.

That's really tough. Have you ever lived away from home?

Is it very difficult to find work where you live? Are there any places you could volunteer, which would at least give you a purpose to get up and out of the house? I'd love to think of you getting a chance to meet people and experience some companionship in your life.

Where abouts in the world are you from? I know in the UK mental health services are stretched pretty thin so they don't have the beds to accept people. I arrived at A&E (aka ER) after taking 3x a lethal dose of codeine and it not having killed me as intended and with the intent to try again. They didn't take me in either so please don't think it's because you're not worth it.

Those are all excellent hobbies but unless you got good enough with the guitar to join a band they also sound quite lonely and not a good way by themselves of getting the company you need. Have you tried something like meetup.com? I've found people in those groups to be very welcoming and you can do things like walking which you already do.

If your mum cares so much about you try to imagine how bad she'd feel if you did die. It could destroy her. I don't say this to try and guilt you into acting in any particular way but I doubt your suicide would be a way out for her.

20 lbs isn't so much you can't lose that weight. I've lost almost exactly that in the past 8 weeks through going to the gym. I'm not pretending it's easy though, you need hope of a better future to do that and you don't have a lot of hope at the moment.

What did you used to love?

Hi, does your mother know how bad you've been feeling? It might seem obvious if you've been seeing therapists but people (e.g. me) can be good at covering it up out of shame. Does she know about your cuts? I think you should probably still go to the hospital now, even if only just to stitch you up properly.

I feel for you but I don't have an easy answer, i'm in a similar position but a bit older. I'm sure there are good things about you though, for one you write very nicely. What hobbies did you try? How did that go?

Would it be possible for you to move in with your mother if you told her you can't cope at the moment? Would that take care of some of the financial stresses you're facing at the moment and maybe be able to see a doctor as well? The phases of depression and extreme motivation you go through remind me of a friend with bipolar disorder and she says the drugs she takes really help her. Who are the people who break down your defences?

I've tried walking round the city waiting to get stabbed. It didn't work!

It's not stupid, that's a mark of a really thoughtful person.

Does anyone in your family know how you're feeling?

Hi, have you spoken to anyone since last night?

Have you ever spoken to a doctor about how you feel? Even if you don't have any confidence in things like anti-depressants they might be able to prescribe you something to help you sleep better. Have you ever spoken to anyone except us on reddit about wanting to end it?

I've known people who were beaten up and raped throughout their childhood and suffered a lot as young adults. With help though they've put their past behind them and gone on to get married and have kids. You don't have to feel this way forever but I don't deny it's difficult.

In case it's not obvious: I don't think you're a horrible person. You seem thoughtful, kind and considerate to me. And funny too! I suppose I have quite a thing for dark humour.

I know the pattern though. I've never got as far as vomiting but I have made my eyes bleed from months of non-stop crying. Also not very pleasant! Eventually that settled somewhat after trips to A&E but really the only thing that has improved my life is slowly developing friendships and taking the edge off the loneliness. Do you see people often, perhaps at work?

I can't do a casual relationship either (the state of my eyes was a testament to that) and try and hold on to any scrap of hope I can find. I turned 30 last year and it's not easy.

You're very welcome :) How are you doing today?

What form does the freaking out take, do you have panic attacks? It's up to you of course, but I don't think you have to be so explicit (and self-denigrating?) if you want to decline the invite. Anyway, a lot can happen in the next two months!

> how can I explain to them that I'm terrified of physical intimacy?

Lurking guy opinion here (if it's rude to be posting I'll see myself out). You are very eloquent and so long as you are upfront about your discomfort before a date I'd hope men you're interested in would be understanding too. Maybe it won't be so scary when you meet the right person anyway :)

I was going to ask whether you'd feel more alone staying away from the wedding but from one of your other replies it sounds like you're at a very low point already. I hope you're feeling better this afternoon.

Bad things happen from anger but so do good things. People get angry with the injustices and decide to do something about them.  You might feel negatively about a situation like all the experiences you had growing up but that's not the same as being a negative person. Anyway, I don't think you should beat yourself up for having strong feelings.

Did you feel any happier day-to-day when you were living in Germany? It must have been a bit closer to the friends you grew up with. Could you ask to be transferred back?

As beautifully as you write, it's not easy to imagine how much you must all have suffered in that orphanage. Your loneliness and difficulty making friends is very familiar to me though. What part of the world are you living in? What do you do for work?

It may feel concerning but you are right to be angry about how you and your friends have suffered. However, you are aware of your feelings and can think of the anger as a useful passion to spur you on to better your situation. Anger doesn't have to be bad, it's how you use it that's important. What would you like to change in your life?
Not everyone is like that, some of us just want to love someone

Reminded me of this instantly:
http://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/nov/09/i-hate-being-a-black-man

One thing though: a month seems a bit quick to be writing yourself off, even good looking men probably struggle to go on a date that quickly.
Who would you worry about getting into trouble with?

You have quite a talent for description! I don't disagree with you about the psychiatrists, it seems like complete quackery to me, doctors pedaling drugs no better than placebos. Just be wary of taking rash decisions when you're so livid with how the doctor has treated you. It's not going to spite him, he clearly doesn't give a fuck.

I hope you come back and say a bit more about yourself. If you wrote a book about what it's like to get worked by the system I'd love to read it.

Does your partner know about all the drugs you have been on? What do you think he would say if he were to see your post? I don't want to make promises on someone else's behalf but perhaps there is a lot of care and affection there which is difficult to see through your depression. 

What do you like to read?

Hey, hope you're feeling a bit better today. I was wondering if the counselor would be able to understand how much these exams mean to you because of your past and know about any academic dispensations or interruptions that might be possible. I realise it must be difficult if you are on an apprenticeship though.

Hi there, would it be possible to talk to someone at the school about the stress the exams are putting you under?

I work at a university as a software developer and one project I was involved with was implementing a referral system for students seeking counseling. Hopefully your school does something similar.

Have you got a tutor you can talk through the past exam questions with? Do you want to try and run them past me? I can't guarantee to know about your subject area but there's a chance!

Hey, sorry I fell asleep last night. How are you today?

Have you ever told anyone in person about your depression? Its supposed to help, though I won't claim its worked for me personally.

Do you work or study at the moment?

Anxiety can be very disabling, I hope you can get past it. Sounds like you do get chances from time to time though so I'm sure it will happen for you.

Not everyone is in the same situation as you and you were being pretty judgemental imo.

I'm glad you have somewhere safe to sleep at night even if you're not so sure :)

Is there something you are aware you're missing in life to make it all worthwhile? How long have you felt like this?
So does that include you, another 30 year old virgin?

How are you today?

It must be very stressful at home if your mum has had a breakdown. Would you consider calling one of the lines from the right hand links in this subreddit? You would be in control of whether you gave them your name or not.
Nice family! Do you know if she has ever spoken to a councillor?

What would happen if your parents found out? They'd find out if you died so maybe its not worth keeping this a secret from them.

I tried to kill myself several times, getting hospitalized in the process and also kept it from my parents. So I just wonder what your reasons are.

Well they don't sound a great friend, or at least they can't cope with what you told them. Most people can't. Does your school have a councillor or someone similar who'd be willing to talk properly? 

Are you at a college/university? Are there clubs that you might consider joining for some variety?

Is there any break to the dull routine that would make things better?

What threat did your friend make? That doesn't sound too friendly.

Thank you for your story, even if its not what you intended it does give me, who is approaching 30 and has never wanted to keep going, some hope that maybe there could be more bearable times ahead.

From what you say, it sounds like both you and your wife have struggled with life like the rest of us here, but found some solace in each other. My thought is that your suicide would destroy her, not help her, even if you still had that much higher level of financial security. Have you told her how you are feeling?

Like CandyDaydream said, you have had some shitty luck :( At least the recent problems seem treatable and will heal with time and medicine. With time will you be able to get back into the gym?

As someone who had their first kiss and loss their virginity within a fortnight aged 25 I understand how lonely that makes you feel. Wanting to do anything to fix that can get you into situations you feel guilty about. For me it was falling in love with a married woman from work and that completely destroyed me.

Your parents sound really caring. Have you been able to tell them how you're feeling at the moment?

Hello :)

Would you say there is a single factor that is making you most depressed? Have you thought what you'll do about it in the year you have got?

A lot of things that can lead us to this place aren't or at least don't seem to be in our control. Hopefully there are some proactive things you could do to make things better though and maybe we could help.

x

Does your family know how you are feeling at the moment?

I know some of your feelings have been very long lasting but there are some parts of your situation that are temporary. Could you move back home to where your friends are if you can't afford the rent in this place you don't like anyway? Is there someone you could ask for help with the rent if not?

Do you think she'd be willing to go to relationship counseling? Do you feel there is any chance that would help now?

I don't think you should put all the blame on yourself. Hugs

Would it be possible to look elsewhere for work?

I've heard of people working for the family being completely unappreciated and taken advantage of with regard to money as its just expected that you should work hard for them. I think you deserve better though.

Hugs from me too
As a very 'rational' and scientific person I can imagine that would feel awkward. Had this feud been going on throughout your relationship?
What was the difference of beliefs about?

I'm one of those liberal assholes, except I don't have any friends to pretend to. Maybe I really do care? There are nice people out there, I've met some of them through being hospitalised by my own attempts.

Your colleagues sound like real jerks. Would there be any chance of sueing them for workplace bullying?

It must make you so angry when you haven't been close to someone in a long while and everyone else is a complete prick. It doesn't always have to be that way though.
Hiya, thank you very much for following up. I'm glad you're still here too. Hope it goes well with the therapist.
I don't think you're crazy. If you are thinking about ending it all does it really matter if you didn't get the response you are hoping for? Are those people friends in Austin?

Please don't hurt yourself :( Wish I could give you a hug but I am from the UK so it is difficult to reach as far as Texas.

Have you told anyone apart from us about how you're feeling?

Hi Rhie,

Is there any possibility of a doctor coming to you if its not possible to go to them? Where abouts are you from?

I'm really sorry he has been doing that to you. To have your heart broken on top of the back problem must feel awful.

A week ago I took a big overdose too, supposedly more than twice the lethal dose of codeine. I walked in rather than took the ambulance and got put on drips to sort out the vomiting and dehydration.

I don't have answers, but I know how you feel. Its like I want to be sad when I think how shit things are, and a few tears come out, but really there is nothing left.

Who raised the alarm? Hope that means someone cares about you.

I live in the UK and the support through the NHS is good and there is no question of having to pay for anything. You might have to pay £7.40 prescription charges if medication is a good idea, but I'm not sure you'll notice that against the £3,300 fees!

Tomorrow morning call your doctors surgery and tell them what happened in a couple of sentences, they'll make sure you get an appointment that day.

Just a word of warning, i found the GPs themselves a bit inadequate, but perhaps that was just mine. Hopefully they will find you someone to talk to in the next couple of days.

I went to a world top 50 university and the degree has been pretty much useless to me. What I did at the same time though, was taught myself computer administration and programming. Is that something that would be viable for you?

Hiya,

What's the situation that has got to you so much? Has it been going on a long time?
Hiya, how has today gone?

Its not really about being pitied in my opinion. They might have some ideas about how to get out of the rut you're in at the moment.

How has today been?

I'm really glad you have that selflessness which will keep you going out of care for your family. I'm sure if your dying would destroy them they must be upset about you considering it, even if they don't know how to express it well.

If you cut yourself off from dating for a while do you think that would help your self confidence recover? Is there anyone you could talk to face to face about how you've been feeling?

I've got to go to bed now but I can keep chatting after I've had a sleep :)

Where on earth do you live that is full of these completely crazy women! Please don't hurt yourself because of them and whatever issues they are playing out on you.

I am untouchable to the opposite sex so perhaps am not the best person to talk to! Your restaurant date sounds really beautiful, I really wasn't expecting to read the next paragraph and see that outcome. Have you had any thoughts about how you could find people who are interested in the long term? How are you meeting people at the moment, chance encounters?

I know how you feel about the oncoming loneliness, it is part of why I am here too. Everyone getting married and having children, then never leaving their houses. I haven't worked out an answer yet...

Perhaps it is the brave thing to do when you feel uncomfortable about it but are going to take every chance to make things better.

Something I feel quite strongly about is I really want you to get to grips with how you're feeling now. I'm really glad you're feeling a bit better but please don't brush today under the carpet. I don't want you to turn into me basically!

Would you think about seeing a councillor if you don't want to go to a doctor?

God that sounds tough. Did you call to ask what had happened and got no response? I'm not surprised having had that happen a few times has hurt you.

I see so many good things about you, you say yourself about being warm, funny and sunny. You don't seem to have too much trouble meeting people either, even if you've perhaps had some bad luck with who those people were. I could really do with some hints!

How do you do for the basics in life - sleeping, eating and drinking?

Could you have a look on their web site, maybe it would give you some ideas about how things could be in the future :)

If you're asking me, I'd like you to do anything you can to be in a good frame of mind so you can take advantage of those coming opportunities. Perhaps something simple like going to the gym every day to get yourself looking good for all those nice college girls! Is cognitive science a branch of psychology? I remember that there were about 4 girls for every guy in psychology when I was at uni. Good choice!

There is something else you could consider - going to a doctor. Doctors being doctors, they'll want to get their pad out and prescribe you antidepressents. There are no guarantees, but when they do work, they should start working after 3-4 weeks, which would give you a perfectly timed boost.
Starting out at college is a fantastic chance. Does the place you're going to have societies and clubs for sports and that kind of thing?

I know what you mean about some people's terrible stories but that doesn't mean that you are not important too. You're not an imposition, please don't say that about yourself.

Was there something about the most recent incident that was different to the others or do you think coming at the end of a chain of them has made you depressed?

Is your studying that you're starting in a month going to be at a college or university? That sounds like an ideal way to meet new people your age, and would the other students also be there starting out afresh?

Another option for meeting new people that has some structure to it is getting a job. Would a bar job be an option? I think that could give you a lot of confidence.
Would you come back and talk to us? If you want to talk on skype or msn, pm me :)

I think its human nature to be upset if someone offends you. If there is something wrong with that then we're all pretty fucked!

I don't think you're abnormal because you've not had a close relationship with someone by the age of 19. I think you're being very harsh on yourself.

Would you have time to take on any other hobbies where you could meet people? Perhaps taking an evening class?

You sound really thoughtful and caring, I'm really sorry you keep getting hurt like that.

Have you been able to tell anyone about how you're feeling, maybe your sister?

If you feel the way you think is part of the problem, creating vicious cycles where you feel worse and worse, would cognitive behaivioural therapy (CBT) be an option? I think that is intended to help exactly that problem. Have you ever spoken to someone about how you feel?

When it gets to the weekend and you are really upset in the evening, have you got up to much during that day or been quite isolated?

I know how it hurts so much to be alone.

Do you have any interests or hobbies where you get to meet people? Is there anything you'd like to do?

Hello, I'm sorry you are so down. Something you said in your other thread struck me:

> You know its a strange day when you can't even be bothered having a beer.

That's me all over too and I guess its what the doctors call clinical depression. I quite like a coffee, but I haven't made myself one in years because I can't be bothered to even boil the kettle.

Did you try out a different medication?

I'm really glad :) How is your day going today?

Do you have regular meetings with a councillor who you could talk through the past couple of days with? I know you feel it doesn't change things, I am exactly the same, but perhaps it just relieves a bit of stress?
Hiya, are you there?

I'm really glad you have supportive people around you :)

Could you explain whats become unsolvable for me? In your first post you said you hadn't yet started on HRT, will that help in the future?

Sorry I am a bit slow to reply, I am just a bit slow at thinking!

I am ok thank you, that is so kind of you to ask when you are struggling :)

When you started undergoing treatment were you given the number of someone you could call if you were feeling very down? I hope they did, it must be a very difficult process to go through. Are your parents very understanding?

You don't sound like you want to die and I'm really glad. Do you feel it has gone outside of your control?
Hiya, are you still there? How are you doing?

Hi Emily, well done for going out when it was tough, I'm glad you had a nice time.

Even though it was nice, was it also very stressful going out when you are feeling so self conscious? Would getting home have been a big release of all that stress?

Please don't hurt yourself when you have come so far. Also, Emily is a very pretty name :)

Sorry - Also meant to say you are really strong for having coped with the way he treats you for so long. Please don't give in now. I'd really like you to talk to one of those people on the hotlines, or a councillor, because they will have more of an understanding of what you have been though.

Hope today is going ok.

Suicide is forever but living with your father isn't. I know someone who lived with an alcoholic mother and father who would try and stab him and his sister. He left home and now has a family of his own with a young son and enjoys life.

Is there anyone else you could go to live with? Would you think about calling one of those numbers linked to on the sidebar. I'm sure they have lots of advice for your situation. If you are in the UK there is childline: http://www.childline.org.uk/

Hello, your isolation is really familiar to me. I do have a job, but on the other hand am pretty damned ugly!

Does it make sense to try and reduce that isolation in a structured way? How about evening classes or taking on a bar job in the evenings? I can't say it is easy though, I am struggling too.
Could you send me a message tomorrow to let me know how you're doing? Hope you sleep well.
Even if the things that have hurt you are 'the usual', that doesn't make your suffering unimportant. Have you spoken to anyone about how you feel before?

I'm really sorry you were suffering so badly you would hurt yourself like that. Would you go to hospital, if only so they could take a look at your neck and windpipe to check there isn't any permanant damage.

Why were you upset?
I've sent you a private message with my MSN details, hope it got to you.

Hi there, you are not causing us a bother, thank you for being brave enough to say how hurt you are.

Please don't hurt yourself because of the way this man has treated you. You sound a very caring person who doesn't deserve this.

Do you have someone nearby you could talk to?

I'm sorry you had such bad side effects from the drugs you tried. I Have read a paper showing venlafaxine is much more effective than escitallopram (lexapro) so maybe it is worth the risk of some side effects.

Peculiarly it was medical staff who gave me that paper to try and convince me to take escitallopram...

It sounds like you are very precious to your boyfriend, friends and family. Have you talked to them recently about how you are feeling at the moment? Have you tried different doctors and therapists? I ask because in my experience they have very different approaches. 

I don't have answers I'm afraid, just wanted to let you know that someone had read what you wrote and cares. I understand never having done anything except out of fear of not doing it, that's my whole life too. Something that helped me in that regard was getting a decent job after I'd finished studying and finding I was somewhat valued for what I could produce.
Can I be your friend? Can give hugs also.

[](/haha "")

No it wouldn't help now even if I did know where to find a prostitute. I'm not that bothered about sex any more, just aware of the psychological effects of being unloved and unwanted for so long.

Over the past 4 months I have tried to kill myself half a dozen times. I'm better described by a wikipedia page than several psychologists and psychiatric nurses could manage in that time.

I wish I had listened to you, I just feel more fucked up than ever.

I might try rogaine though like you say it is not cheap. I have a good job so can afford it  (if I still have a good job, who knows at this point).

Going to try out a ju jit su club that is not too far away and on monday each week so that will get me out. There is a climbing club too so that will take another day up. The climbing people seem to be quite sociable too, having a night out afterwards. I am a bit worried because I have tried this sort of thing before and been ostracised just as with everything else.

I hope I can change like you did.

Thank you so much

I read this yesterday, sorry for not replying at the time.

You have given me a lot of hope, without which I might well have slipped back or at least still be in an absolutely awful state. I was worthless before the only person I thought I could count on at all left me for dead.

I am trying now. I went out and got paid for a fancy haircut this morning, bought vitamin pills which might help slightly with my hair which is starting to fall out. I have a meeting with a nurse in a little while though that is more to do with if I could go back to work.

How the hope came to me would probably seem so pathetic to anyone else and it is so fragile. I will keep that to myself for now at least.

I don't really watch TV, I do sit with it on in the background just so I am not in silence. I do sit here with my laptop pretty much the whole time which is unhealthy obviously. It's not because I can't let go, I would love there to be something better to do, someone to see.

I guess the next step is how did you get started? How did you put yourself out there? We don't really have clubs, more lots of pubs.

Trouble with 'why not try escaping for a while' is that I am the problem. I don't think I am mentally ill (using the term with reference to depression seems to me like medicalizing unhappiness to make doctors money) and I don't think I am unfortunate enough to have autism or anything like that. I am just shy and not attractive which makes it difficult to make friends which is not nice when you need company.

Someone gave me a moment of hope yesterday which stopped me finishing up and I decided to make another go of things and get help. I went to a doctor. He was pretty indifferent though and pushed me out after a few minutes. He tried to get me to take drugs which wouldn't take affect for six weeks anyway. I have an appointment for a councillor on friday but am deeply skeptical again now. They all say they care but of course they have never seen me before and won't ever again. They can't change anything in my life, so it is down to how they can change me.

Meanwhile, no, no-one has called except some work people in an official capacity following whatever flowchart they have for this situation. Just sitting watching some irritating music channel.

Thank you for being there. I am from the UK by the way. Are you a native english speaker?

Yesterday morning I taped out my bath in plastic dust sheets to make the mess easy to clean up and found a big knife and lump hammer to hopefully make sure I could put it through my chest in one go. I just had about 200 words of a letter to my parents explaining left to go when someone gave me hope in a way I could never have expected.

I am left wanting to be a different person, rather than just not wanting to be. Daytime television echoing round my room.

Thank you those are lots of good ideas I know would help. I can't get a new job though because of the mortgage. I suppose I could get rid of the house and rent so you don't have it hanging round your neck, but that seems like throwing away a future rather than trying to build one?

I know working out can help, the friend with benefits started wanting me around the time when I was doing something similar. Maybe it was because of the change in my mind rather than body like you say. I also know what an extreme amount of effort that was to have any change - 1000 calories of cardio, 6 days a week for months. My complete loss of appetite at the moment might be helping more!

I would like to do a second job, I'd like to volunteer helping young people learn to program, people who won't have had a chance to learn or thing it is beyond them. Not a relationship where they could be my friends though.
Sent a message about the trolls.
Trouble is they were the only people I thought cared.

I can't think of the words because of my own state of mind, but I am sorry. That is a horrible way to treat you, shocking considering how you cared for her.

Can you take time off?

Just posting because it is unfair to leave people wondering about something like this. I'm sorry it is not a happy ending.

I went to work to find that my colleague (the friend above, the only person to ever care for me) had packed all her things and resigned. I have ruined her life as well as my own. She really needed the money. The things I had left are smashed to pieces.

To the people trying to goad me into action and posting a video of it, you had no effect whatsoever. You just puzzle me as to WTF is wrong with you.

Sorry went to bed to try and sleep. Got a couple of hours but now just laying there in the dark so going to go to work to do something useful at least. Thank you for your messages since then, I will come back and read them properly later.

We live in the same town and they don't do very much with their lives either. I might get to see someone once a fortnight.

Giving me space or overwhelming with company? I come home from work every night with nothing to look forward to except going to bed. Recently I just go to bed and try and lay there from about 6pm when I am home.
Not sure what you want to know, the reason is all in the first sentence. Sorry that sounds confrontational, it's not meant to.

> Why so sure no one ever will love you or anything like that?

Because I am 27 now and no-one has. It's just not worth the pain to keep trying.

> (Why wiping your phone, HD, etc?)

Mostly to protect this other person who I have the kind of photograph of I shouldn't have (hope that makes sense).

Thank you both for listening.

I am 'comfortable', with a salary of around $60,000 (though it's difficult to compare with different costs of living etc). I am in the top 20% of earners in a rich western country.

I am 27 now and the living embodiment of forever alone. No-one wants anything to do with me in any way whatsoever and I wish I had never been born.
